summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關訊息：加高電子於法說會表示泰國新廠已啟用，以滿足客戶海外生產需求，並聚焦AI光通訊、智慧眼鏡與智慧汽車應用。這反映客戶要求海外產能的壓力，正推動台商在泰國建立跨國生產能力，跨廠協同與管理需求隨之浮現。
summary_en: Only one relevant item today: Kaikao Electronics said its new Thailand plant is operational to meet customers' overseas production needs, focusing on AI optical communication, smart glasses and smart vehicles. Customer demand for overseas capacity is pushing cross-border production in Thailand.
